items.name: Beasiswa LPDP STEM Industri Strategis (Magister & Doktor)
items.fields: STEM industri strategis (kesehatan, pangan, energi, maritim, pertahanan, digitalisasi/AI & semikonduktor, hilirisasi, material & manufaktur maju) + bidang pendukung (bisnis & ekonomi, kebijakan publik & hukum, kewirausahaan/industri kreatif)
items.coverage: Skema penuh: biaya pendaftaran, tuition, buku, riset tesis/disertasi, transport, visa, asuransi kesehatan, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup bulanan; tersedia juga skema parsial (kriteria Umum dan CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI)
items.eligibility: WNI; Magister IPK min. 3,00 dan usia maks. 35 th, Doktor IPK 3,25 dan usia maks. 40 th (kriteria Umum); ada kriteria Afirmasi (Papua, Daerah Afirmasi, Prasejahtera, Disabilitas) dengan syarat lebih ringan; LN Magister IELTS 6.5, Doktor IELTS 7.0 (Afirmasi IELTS 6.0).
items.english_test: Magister: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58 / Duolingo 120; Doktor: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Afirmasi: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
items.notes: Tahap 2 2026 sudah ditutup (pendaftaran 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026, kuliah paling cepat Jan 2027). Jadwal 2027 belum diumumkan; secara historis tahap 1 dibuka sekitar Januari. Kategori Afirmasi kini masuk dalam program STEM/SHARE. Pemegang LoA unconditional tidak wajib sertifikat bahasa Inggris. Situs utama lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id tidak bisa diakses langsung saat pengecekan; data dari buku panduan resmi LPDP.

en.name: LPDP STEM Strategic Industries Scholarship (Master's & Doctorate)
en.fields: Strategic-industry STEM (health, food, energy, maritime, defence, digitalisation/AI & semiconductors, downstreaming, advanced materials & manufacturing) + supporting fields (business & economics, public policy & law, entrepreneurship/creative industries)
en.coverage: Full scheme: application fees, tuition, books, thesis/dissertation research, transport, visa, health insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance; partial schemes also available (General and civil servant/military/police criteria)
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens; Master's GPA min. 3.00 and max. age 35, Doctorate GPA 3.25 and max. age 40 (General criteria); Affirmative criteria (Papua, affirmative regions, low-income, disability) with lighter requirements; overseas Master's IELTS 6.5, Doctorate IELTS 7.0 (Affirmative IELTS 6.0).
en.english_test: Master's: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58 / Duolingo 120; Doctorate: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Affirmative: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
en.notes: Round 2 of 2026 is closed (applications 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026, study starting Jan 2027 at the earliest). The 2027 schedule has not been announced; historically round 1 opens around January. Affirmative categories are now part of the STEM/SHARE programmes. Holders of an unconditional LoA do not need an English certificate. The main site lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id could not be reached during the check; data taken from the official LPDP guidebook.

items.name: Beasiswa LPDP SHARE (Social, Humanities, Art for People, Religious Study, Education)
items.fields: Ilmu sosial, humaniora, seni, budaya, keagamaan, pendidikan
items.coverage: Skema penuh: dana pendidikan (pendaftaran, tuition, buku, riset) dan dana pendukung (transport, visa, asuransi, tunjangan hidup); skema parsial untuk kriteria Umum dan CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI
items.eligibility: WNI kriteria Umum, CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI, atau Afirmasi (Papua, Daerah Afirmasi, Prasejahtera, Disabilitas); LN Magister IELTS 6.5, Doktor IELTS 7.0 (Afirmasi IELTS 6.0); Putra-Putri Papua tidak wajib sertifikat bahasa Inggris.
items.english_test: Magister: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58; Doktor: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Afirmasi: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
items.notes: Periode 2026 (tahap 2: 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026) sudah ditutup. Jadwal 2027 belum diumumkan.

en.name: LPDP SHARE Scholarship (Social, Humanities, Art for People, Religious Study, Education)
en.fields: Social sciences, humanities, arts, culture, religious studies, education
en.coverage: Full scheme: education funds (application, tuition, books, research) and support funds (transport, visa, insurance, living allowance); partial scheme for General and civil servant/military/police criteria
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens under General, civil servant/military/police, or Affirmative criteria (Papua, affirmative regions, low-income, disability); overseas Master's IELTS 6.5, Doctorate IELTS 7.0 (Affirmative IELTS 6.0); Papuan applicants do not need an English certificate.
en.english_test: Master's: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58; Doctorate: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Affirmative: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
en.notes: The 2026 period (round 2: 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026) is closed. The 2027 schedule has not been announced.

items.name: Beasiswa LPDP Akselerasi pada Universitas Unggulan
items.fields: Semua bidang di universitas unggulan kategori A; bidang STEM tertentu di kategori B
items.coverage: Pendaftaran, tuition, buku, riset, seminar & publikasi internasional, transport, visa, asuransi, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup, tunjangan keluarga (doktor)
items.eligibility: WNI yang sudah memegang LoA (wajib untuk Magister) dari daftar Universitas Unggulan LPDP; Doktor tanpa LoA wajib IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
items.english_test: Doktor tanpa LoA: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65; pemegang LoA tanpa minimum
items.notes: Putaran 2026 (pendaftaran 6-27 Mar 2026) dan putaran tahap 2 sudah ditutup. Daftar universitas unggulan mencakup kampus top di AS, Inggris, Jerman, Jepang, Singapura, dll.

en.name: LPDP Acceleration Scholarship at Leading Universities
en.fields: All fields at category A leading universities; selected STEM fields at category B
en.coverage: Application, tuition, books, research, international seminars & publications, transport, visa, insurance, arrival allowance, living allowance, family allowance (doctorate)
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens holding an LoA (required for Master's) from LPDP's list of leading universities; Doctorate applicants without an LoA need IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
en.english_test: Doctorate without LoA: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65; LoA holders: no minimum
en.notes: The 2026 round (applications 6-27 Mar 2026) and round 2 are closed. The list of leading universities includes top campuses in the US, UK, Germany, Japan, Singapore and others.

items.name: LPDP-Australia Awards Scholarships (LPDP-AAS)
items.fields: Digitalisasi (AI & semikonduktor), energi, hilirisasi & industrialisasi, kesehatan, ketahanan pangan, maritim, material & manufaktur maju
items.coverage: Tuition, pendaftaran, buku, riset tesis, seminar/publikasi, transport, visa, asuransi, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup bulanan, pelatihan pra-keberangkatan
items.eligibility: WNI lulusan D4/S1 (belum memiliki S2), program Master single degree 24 bulan di ~30 universitas Australia; IELTS 6.5 (tiap band min. 6.0) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84.
items.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 tiap band) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84
items.notes: Putaran untuk mulai kuliah 2027 dibuka 2 Apr-4 Mei 2026 (sudah ditutup). Pendaftaran via portal LPDP. Jadwal putaran berikutnya belum diumumkan.

en.name: LPDP-Australia Awards Scholarships (LPDP-AAS)
en.provider: LPDP (Indonesian Ministry of Finance) & Australian Government (DFAT)
en.fields: Digitalisation (AI & semiconductors), energy, downstreaming & industrialisation, health, food security, maritime, advanced materials & manufacturing
en.coverage: Tuition, application, books, thesis research, seminars/publications, transport, visa, insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance, pre-departure training
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with a D4/Bachelor's degree (no Master's yet), for a 24-month single-degree Master's at ~30 Australian universities; IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 each band) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84.
en.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 each band) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84
en.notes: The round for study starting in 2027 was open 2 Apr-4 May 2026 (closed). Apply via the LPDP portal. The next round has not been announced.

items.name: Beasiswa Doktor Talenta Riset dan Inovasi Nasional BRIN - Jalur Doctor by Research
items.fields: Riset sektor prioritas: kesehatan, pangan, digitalisasi, hilirisasi, pertahanan, material & manufaktur, energi, maritim
items.coverage: Pendaftaran, tuition, seminar & publikasi internasional, transport (LN), visa, asuransi kesehatan, dana darurat
items.eligibility: WNI lulusan S2 (atau D4/S1 langsung doktor dengan LoA unconditional) untuk program doctor by research; LN IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
items.notes: Putaran 2026 (6-27 Mar 2026) sudah ditutup. Daftar LN 2026: 19 program di Inggris, Australia, Rusia, Prancis, Belanda.

en.name: BRIN National Research & Innovation Talent Doctoral Scholarship - Doctor by Research
en.fields: Priority-sector research: health, food, digitalisation, downstreaming, defence, materials & manufacturing, energy, maritime
en.coverage: Application, tuition, international seminars & publications, transport (overseas), visa, health insurance, emergency fund
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with a Master's (or D4/Bachelor's going straight to doctorate with an unconditional LoA) for a doctor-by-research programme; overseas IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
en.notes: The 2026 round (6-27 Mar 2026) is closed. 2026 overseas list: 19 programmes in the UK, Australia, Russia, France and the Netherlands.

items.name: Beasiswa Garuda Sarjana (S1 Luar Negeri)
items.fields: 10 tema prioritas: kesehatan, ketahanan pangan, pertahanan, digitalisasi, hilirisasi industri, material & manufaktur maju, maritim, energi, bisnis & ekonomi, hukum & kebijakan publik
items.coverage: Tuition, biaya pendaftaran, buku, transport, visa, asuransi kesehatan, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup bulanan
items.eligibility: WNI siswa kelas 12 SMA/SMK/MA yang eligible SNBP, IQ min. 110, SAT 1170 atau ikut Tes Bakat Skolastik; untuk kampus LN IELTS 6.5 (tiap band 6.0) / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58.
items.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 tiap band) / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58
items.notes: 2026: Gelombang I 15 Feb-15 Mar, Gelombang II 25 Mei-25 Jun 2026 (keduanya ditutup). Berita Okt 2026 menyebut akan segera dibuka lagi, tetapi belum ada tanggal resmi. Program ini menggantikan peran BIM untuk S1 luar negeri.

en.name: Garuda Undergraduate Scholarship (Overseas Bachelor's)
en.provider: Indonesian Ministry of Higher Education, Science & Technology (Ditjen Saintek), funded by LPDP
en.fields: 10 priority themes: health, food security, defence, digitalisation, industrial downstreaming, advanced materials & manufacturing, maritime, energy, business & economics, law & public policy
en.coverage: Tuition, application fees, books, transport, visa, health insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance
en.eligibility: Indonesian Year 12 students (SMA/SMK/MA) eligible for SNBP, IQ min. 110, SAT 1170 or the Scholastic Aptitude Test; for overseas campuses IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each band) / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58.
en.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 each band) / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58
en.notes: 2026: Wave I 15 Feb-15 Mar, Wave II 25 May-25 Jun 2026 (both closed). News in Oct 2026 said it will reopen soon, but there is no official date yet. This programme replaces BIM for overseas Bachelor's study.

items.coverage: Pendaftaran, tuition, buku, bantuan tugas akhir, transport PP, asuransi kesehatan, tunjangan hidup bulanan, visa & settlement allowance (LN), pendamping untuk penyandang disabilitas

en.name: Indonesia Talent Scholarship (Overseas D4/Bachelor's Scheme)
en.provider: Indonesian Ministry of Primary & Secondary Education (Puspresnas) & LPDP (Ministry of Finance)
en.coverage: Application, tuition, books, final-project support, return transport, health insurance, monthly living allowance, visa & settlement allowance (overseas), companion for students with disability
en.eligibility: Indonesian Year 12 students/graduates who won a medal (gold/silver/bronze/honourable mention) at an international competition facilitated by Puspresnas (e.g. IMO, IPhO, IOI, WorldSkills); English certificate optional.
en.notes: Only for international competition medallists. The schedule is set by Puspresnas and announced on the Puspresnas/LPDP pages; the next round date has not been announced.

items.name: Beasiswa Kemitraan Indonesia (BKI) - S3 Luar Negeri untuk Dosen
items.coverage: Beasiswa studi doktor di luar negeri (rincian komponen di panduan resmi)
items.eligibility: WNI dosen tetap pada perguruan tinggi di bawah Kemdiktisaintek; pendaftaran melalui kualifikasidikti.kemdiktisaintek.go.id.
items.notes: Khusus dosen tetap. Putaran 2026 diumumkan 16 Mar 2026, batas pendaftaran 25 Apr 2026 (sudah ditutup).

en.name: Indonesia Partnership Scholarship (BKI) - Overseas Doctorate for Lecturers
en.provider: Indonesian Ministry of Higher Education, Science & Technology
en.coverage: Scholarship for doctoral study overseas (components listed in the official guide)
en.eligibility: Indonesian permanent lecturers at universities under the Ministry; apply via kualifikasidikti.kemdiktisaintek.go.id.
en.notes: Only for permanent lecturers. The 2026 round was announced 16 Mar 2026 with a deadline of 25 Apr 2026 (closed).

items.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Masters & PhD) - Indonesia
items.fields: Bidang prioritas pembangunan Australia Awards Indonesia
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tiket PP, establishment allowance, tunjangan hidup, OSHC, pelatihan bahasa Inggris (EAP) di Indonesia sebelum berangkat
items.eligibility: WNI yang berdomisili dan mendaftar dari Indonesia, bukan anggota militer aktif, belum menerima AAS jangka panjang dalam 4 tahun terakhir; Master IPK 2,9 (kelompok equity 2,75), PhD IPK 3,0 dan khusus staf universitas/lembaga riset/pembuat kebijakan; Master IELTS 6.0 (equity 4.5), PhD IELTS 6.0-6.5.
items.english_test: Master: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 56 / TOEFL ITP 552 (Equity Target Groups: IELTS 4.5 / PTE 32); PhD non-target: IELTS 6.5 / PTE 61
items.notes: Batas pendaftaran 28 April 2027 pukul 11:00 WIB. Wajib siap mengikuti pelatihan EAP penuh waktu 6 minggu-12 bulan di Indonesia. Dukungan khusus untuk penyandang disabilitas, perempuan dari latar kurang beruntung, dan provinsi target equity.

en.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Masters & PhD) - Indonesia
en.fields: Australia Awards Indonesia development priority areas
en.coverage: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living allowance, OSHC, English (EAP) training in Indonesia before departure
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens living in and applying from Indonesia, not active military, not a recipient of a long-term AAS in the last 4 years; Master's GPA 2.9 (equity groups 2.75), PhD GPA 3.0 and only for university/research-institute staff or policy makers; Master's IELTS 6.0 (equity 4.5), PhD IELTS 6.0-6.5.
en.english_test: Master's: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 56 / TOEFL ITP 552 (Equity Target Groups: IELTS 4.5 / PTE 32); PhD non-target: IELTS 6.5 / PTE 61
en.notes: Applications close 28 April 2027 at 11:00 WIB. You must be ready for full-time EAP training of 6 weeks-12 months in Indonesia. Special support for people with disability, women from disadvantaged backgrounds, and equity target provinces.

items.name: Australia Awards Garuda Scholarships
items.fields: Pendidikan / bidang terkait Program Sekolah Garuda (STEM & pendidikan menengah)
items.coverage: Beasiswa jangka panjang Australia Awards (tuition, tunjangan hidup, tiket, OSHC, pelatihan EAP)
items.eligibility: WNI pemegang S1 yang merupakan kepala sekolah/guru di 12 Sekolah Garuda Transformasi (IPK 3,0, IELTS 5.5) atau guru PPG yang bersedia ditempatkan di Sekolah Garuda Baru (NTT, Babel, Kaltara, Sultra).
items.english_test: SGT: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL ITP 500 / TOEFL iBT 52 / PTE 45; SGB: tidak disebutkan
items.notes: Khusus pendidik Program Sekolah Garuda. Putaran intake 2027 dibuka 1 Feb-31 Mei 2026 (sudah ditutup); jadwal intake 2028 belum diumumkan.

en.name: Australia Awards Garuda Scholarships
en.fields: Education / fields linked to the Garuda Schools Programme (STEM & secondary education)
en.coverage: Long-term Australia Awards scholarship (tuition, living allowance, airfare, OSHC, EAP training)
en.eligibility: Indonesian Bachelor's holders who are principals/teachers at the 12 Garuda Transformation Schools (GPA 3.0, IELTS 5.5) or PPG teachers willing to be placed at New Garuda Schools (NTT, Bangka Belitung, North Kalimantan, Southeast Sulawesi).
en.english_test: SGT: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL ITP 500 / TOEFL iBT 52 / PTE 45; SGB: not stated
en.notes: Only for Garuda Schools Programme educators. The 2027 intake round was open 1 Feb-31 May 2026 (closed); the 2028 intake schedule has not been announced.

items.name: Australia Awards Short Courses (Indonesia)
items.fields: Tema kebijakan tertentu per kursus (mis. AI & kebijakan publik, energi, keamanan siber, ketahanan pangan, reformasi pendidikan tinggi)
items.coverage: Kursus 2 minggu di Australia plus 2 workshop di Indonesia, dibiayai Pemerintah Australia
items.eligibility: Profesional/pegawai dari instansi Indonesia yang relevan dengan tema kursus; pendaftaran per kursus pada periode yang diumumkan.
items.notes: Semua kursus 2026 sudah lewat masa pendaftaran (terakhir 25 Jun 2026). Daftar kursus 2027-2028 sudah dirilis (status TBC) tetapi periode pendaftaran peserta belum diumumkan.

en.name: Australia Awards Short Courses (Indonesia)
en.fields: Specific policy themes per course (e.g. AI & public policy, energy, cyber security, food security, higher-education reform)
en.coverage: 2-week course in Australia plus 2 workshops in Indonesia, funded by the Australian Government
en.eligibility: Professionals/staff of Indonesian institutions relevant to the course theme; apply per course during the announced period.
en.notes: All 2026 courses are past their application period (last on 25 Jun 2026). The 2027-2028 course list has been released (status TBC), but participant application periods have not been announced.

items.name: ACIAR John Allwright Fellowship
items.fields: Riset pertanian, perikanan, kehutanan, ekonomi terkait proyek ACIAR
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tiket PP, establishment allowance, tunjangan hidup, OSHC, program akademik pengantar, biaya pra-kursus bahasa Inggris bila perlu, tiket fieldwork
items.eligibility: WNI ilmuwan/ekonom yang terlibat proyek ACIAR dalam 24 bulan terakhir, pegawai tetap/kontrak jangka panjang, minimal S1; hanya Master by Research atau PhD; tes IELTS/TOEFL/PTE terbaru.
items.english_test: IELTS / TOEFL / PTE (skor sesuai syarat universitas)
items.notes: Intake 2027 sudah ditutup. Factsheet ACIAR menyebut pendaftaran biasanya 1 Feb-30 Apr setiap tahun via OASIS, tetapi tanggal putaran berikutnya belum dikonfirmasi.

en.name: ACIAR John Allwright Fellowship
en.fields: Agricultural, fisheries, forestry and economics research linked to ACIAR projects
en.coverage: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living allowance, OSHC, introductory academic programme, pre-course English if needed, fieldwork airfares
en.eligibility: Indonesian scientists/economists involved in an ACIAR project in the last 24 months, permanent or long-term contract staff, at least a Bachelor's degree; Master by Research or PhD only; recent IELTS/TOEFL/PTE test.
en.english_test: IELTS / TOEFL / PTE (score as required by the university)
en.notes: The 2027 intake is closed. The ACIAR factsheet says applications usually run 1 Feb-30 Apr each year via OASIS, but the next round dates are not confirmed.

items.name: Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarship
items.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), dikelola universitas
items.fields: Semua bidang (program riset: Master by Research dan PhD)
items.coverage: Offset tuition, stipend biaya hidup, tunjangan biaya tambahan riset (tergantung universitas)
items.eligibility: Terbuka bagi mahasiswa internasional termasuk WNI untuk program riset (HDR) di universitas Australia; seleksi dan syarat (termasuk bahasa Inggris) ditetapkan tiap universitas.
items.notes: Mendaftar langsung ke universitas; tiap kampus punya putaran dan tenggat sendiri (cek situs universitas tujuan). Doktor 3-4 tahun, Master riset hingga 2 tahun.

en.name: Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarship
en.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), administered by universities
en.fields: All fields (research programmes: Master by Research and PhD)
en.coverage: Tuition offset, living-cost stipend, allowance for extra research costs (depends on the university)
en.eligibility: Open to international students, including Indonesians, for research degrees (HDR) at Australian universities; selection and requirements (including English) are set by each university.
en.notes: Apply directly to the university; each campus has its own rounds and deadlines (check the target university's website). Doctorate 3-4 years, research Master's up to 2 years.

items.name: Destination Australia Scholarship
items.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), disalurkan via kampus regional
items.coverage: Tunjangan studi di kampus regional Australia
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa domestik dan internasional yang kuliah penuh waktu di kampus regional Australia; kelayakan internasional berbeda per kampus (sebagian kampus hanya untuk domestik).
items.notes: Pendaftaran langsung ke kampus penerima dana. Contoh: Flinders University (terbuka untuk internasional, putaran 2026 ditutup 13 Mar 2026); UOW hanya untuk domestik. Halaman resmi Kemendik Australia belum memuat jadwal putaran 2027.

en.name: Destination Australia Scholarship
en.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), distributed through regional campuses
en.fields: Depends on the programmes set by the campus
en.coverage: Study allowance at regional Australian campuses
en.eligibility: Domestic and international students studying full-time at a regional Australian campus; international eligibility differs by campus (some campuses are domestic-only).
en.notes: Apply directly to the funded campus. Examples: Flinders University (open to international students, 2026 round closed 13 Mar 2026); UOW is domestic-only. The Australian Department of Education page does not yet list the 2027 round schedule.

items.name: ACU Executive Dean's International Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan sebagian tuition (fee waiver); berita resmi ACU menyebut juga dukungan perjalanan/relokasi dan biaya visa
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S1/S2 dengan prestasi akademik sangat baik; Indonesia termasuk negara sasaran (Asia Tenggara).
items.notes: Tidak perlu aplikasi beasiswa terpisah; dinilai dari aplikasi studi. Halaman tidak mencantumkan tanggal/intake 2027 - konfirmasi ke AskACU.

en.name: ACU Executive Dean's International Scholarship
en.coverage: Partial tuition fee waiver; official ACU news also mentions travel/relocation support and visa costs
en.amount: Up to 20% of tuition per year
en.eligibility: New international Bachelor's/Master's students with excellent academic results; Indonesia is a target country (Southeast Asia).
en.notes: No separate scholarship application; assessed from the study application. The page does not list 2027 dates/intakes - confirm with AskACU.

items.name: ACU International Launch Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru yang mendaftar program Computer Science atau Data Science di ACU.
items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi formal. Jenjang dan tanggal tidak disebutkan di halaman.

en.name: ACU International Launch Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: New international students applying for Computer Science or Data Science at ACU.
en.notes: No formal application. Level and dates are not stated on the page.

items.name: Vice-Chancellor's International High Achievers Scholarship (VCIHAS)
items.coverage: Potongan 50% tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Nilai keseluruhan minimal 95% pada kualifikasi tertinggi, mulai S1/S2 2027, memenuhi syarat akademik & bahasa Inggris CDU, tidak menerima beasiswa sponsor lain; esai pendukung maks. 600 kata.
items.notes: Perlu aplikasi VCIHAS terpisah setelah mendaftar kuliah. Wajib GPA min. 5.3 tanpa nilai gagal.

en.name: Vice-Chancellor's International High Achievers Scholarship (VCIHAS)
en.coverage: 50% tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: Overall result of at least 95% in the highest qualification, starting a Bachelor's/Master's in 2027, meeting CDU academic & English requirements, not receiving another sponsor scholarship; supporting essay max. 600 words.
en.notes: A separate VCIHAS application is needed after applying for the course. Minimum GPA 5.3 with no failed units.

items.name: CDU Global Merit Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru yang mulai 2026/2027, kuliah penuh waktu on-campus di Sydney, Alice Springs, atau Darwin, dan memenuhi syarat masuk.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar program yang memenuhi syarat (TAFE, S1, S2, riset).

en.name: CDU Global Merit Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: New international students starting in 2026/2027, studying full-time on campus in Sydney, Alice Springs or Darwin, and meeting entry requirements.
en.notes: Assessed automatically when applying for an eligible programme (TAFE, Bachelor's, Master's, research).

items.name: CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional Bachelor of Nursing yang mulai 2027, penuh waktu on-campus di Sydney atau Darwin, memenuhi syarat masuk.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar.

en.name: CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: International Bachelor of Nursing students starting in 2027, full-time on campus in Sydney or Darwin, meeting entry requirements.
en.notes: Assessed automatically on application.

items.name: CDU International College Scholarship - China and East Asia
items.fields: Diploma of Business Studies, Diploma of IT, Accelerated International Masters Qualifying Program
items.coverage: Potongan tuition tahun pertama
items.eligibility: Warga negara Indonesia (termasuk daftar negara), mahasiswa baru full-fee & biaya sendiri untuk 2026/2027, lulus wawancara.
items.notes: Indonesia disebut eksplisit. Potongan diberikan saat enrolment, tidak untuk deposit.

en.name: CDU International College Scholarship - China and East Asia
en.fields: Diploma of Business Studies, Diploma of IT, Accelerated International Masters Qualifying Program
en.coverage: First-year tuition reduction
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens (among listed countries), new full-fee self-funded students for 2026/2027, passing an interview.
en.notes: Indonesia is named explicitly. The reduction is applied at enrolment, not to the deposit.

items.name: International Student Scholarship Program - Southeast Asia and Northeast Asia
items.coverage: Pengurangan tuition (biaya beasiswa 10% di bawah biaya kursus)
items.eligibility: Warga negara Asia Tenggara/Timur laut yang memenuhi syarat, memenuhi syarat akademik & bahasa Inggris KBS, bukan mahasiswa bersponsor; diajukan sebelum menerima Offer.
items.notes: Dokumen versi Juli 2026 (biaya 2026). Daftar negara tidak dirinci - konfirmasi kelayakan WNI ke KBS. Kuota terbatas tiap trimester.

en.name: International Student Scholarship Program - Southeast Asia and Northeast Asia
en.coverage: Tuition reduction (scholarship fee 10% below course fee)
en.eligibility: Eligible citizens of Southeast/Northeast Asia meeting KBS academic & English requirements, not sponsored students; must be requested before accepting the Offer.
en.notes: July 2026 document (2026 fees). The country list is not detailed - confirm eligibility for Indonesian citizens with KBS. Limited places each trimester.

items.name: Torrens University Motivational Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru berpaspor negara Asia Tenggara (termasuk Indonesia) dan wilayah lain yang ditentukan; wajib beban studi penuh waktu.
items.notes: Isi International Student Scholarship Form. Halaman masih menyebut mulai 2026 - konfirmasi untuk intake 2027. Kuota terbatas.

en.name: Torrens University Motivational Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: New international students holding a passport from Southeast Asia (including Indonesia) and other specified regions; full-time study load required.
en.notes: Complete the International Student Scholarship Form. The page still refers to 2026 starts - confirm for the 2027 intake. Limited places.

items.name: Three Pillars BMIHMS Hospitality Scholarship
items.provider: Torrens University Australia (Blue Mountains International Hotel Management School)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru program BMIHMS (S1/S2).
items.notes: Detail kriteria pada halaman beasiswa masing-masing.

en.name: Three Pillars BMIHMS Hospitality Scholarship
en.provider: Torrens University Australia (Blue Mountains International Hotel Management School)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: New international students in BMIHMS programmes (Bachelor's/Master's).
en.notes: Criteria details on each scholarship's page.

items.name: Tasmanian International Scholarship (TIS)
items.fields: Semua bidang (kecuali beberapa program, mis. Kedokteran)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi (selama nilai memuaskan)
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S1/S2 coursework; dinilai dari IPK kumulatif kualifikasi tertinggi sebelumnya (min. 1 tahun).
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar; hasil tercantum di offer letter. Sebagian besar program tanpa tanggal tutup.

en.name: Tasmanian International Scholarship (TIS)
en.fields: All fields (except some programmes, e.g. Medicine)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study (while results are satisfactory)
en.eligibility: New international Bachelor's/coursework Master's students; assessed on the cumulative GPA of the highest previous qualification (min. 1 year).
en.notes: Assessed automatically on application; the result is shown in the offer letter. Most programmes have no closing date.

items.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Undergraduate (2027)
items.fields: Semua bidang (tier tertinggi tidak untuk Kedokteran & Nursing)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition per tahun selama masa program
items.eligibility: Lulus SMA/setara, mendaftar S1 CRICOS dan memenuhi syarat akademik tier, mulai pertama kali 2027; tidak untuk kampus Sydney City.
items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi; otomatis dinilai. First-come-first-served sampai kuota habis; tidak bisa ditunda.

en.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Undergraduate (2027)
en.fields: All fields (top tier not for Medicine & Nursing)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction per year for the programme duration
en.eligibility: Completed high school or equivalent, applying for a CRICOS Bachelor's and meeting the tier's academic requirement, commencing for the first time in 2027; not for the Sydney City campus.
en.notes: No application; assessed automatically. First come, first served until places run out; cannot be deferred.

items.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Postgraduate (2027)
items.fields: Semua bidang coursework (AUD 10.000 untuk Teaching, Social Work, Business Analytics, ICT, dll.)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition per tahun selama masa program
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S2 coursework (min. 1 tahun) yang memenuhi syarat akademik, mulai 2027; tidak untuk kampus Sydney City, HDR, atau Nursing pre-registration.
items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi; dibuka hingga kuota sesi terpenuhi.

en.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Postgraduate (2027)
en.fields: All coursework fields (AUD 10,000 for Teaching, Social Work, Business Analytics, ICT, etc.)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction per year for the programme duration
en.eligibility: New international coursework Master's students (min. 1 year) meeting academic requirements, starting in 2027; not for the Sydney City campus, HDR, or pre-registration Nursing.
en.notes: No application; open until each session's quota is filled.

items.name: UniSC Global Future Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa program
items.eligibility: Pemegang paspor negara yang memenuhi syarat (Indonesia termasuk), mendaftar program S1/S2 coursework/pathway dan mulai kuliah di 2027.
items.notes: Otomatis tercantum di offer. Dapat digabung dengan International Welcome Grant. Halaman tidak menyebut kampus UniSC Adelaide secara khusus.

en.name: UniSC Global Future Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the programme duration
en.eligibility: Passport holders of eligible countries (including Indonesia), applying for a Bachelor's/coursework Master's/pathway programme and starting in 2027.
en.notes: Shown automatically in the offer. Can be combined with the International Welcome Grant. The page does not specifically mention the UniSC Adelaide campus.

items.name: UniSC Bright Future Scholarship
items.fields: Nursing, Prosthetics & Orthotics, Engineering, Cyber Security, Social Work, Engineering Project Management
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa program
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional pada program yang tercantum, mulai kuliah di 2027.
items.notes: Otomatis tercantum di offer; hanya bisa digabung dengan Welcome Grant.

en.name: UniSC Bright Future Scholarship
en.fields: Nursing, Prosthetics & Orthotics, Engineering, Cyber Security, Social Work, Engineering Project Management
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the programme duration
en.eligibility: International students in the listed programmes, starting in 2027.
en.notes: Shown automatically in the offer; can only be combined with the Welcome Grant.

items.name: UniSC International Welcome Grant
items.coverage: Kredit ke tuition/biaya universitas senilai biaya visa pelajar (tidak termasuk OSHC)
items.eligibility: Pemohon utama visa pelajar baru dengan CoE UniSC, min. 48 unit di UniSC, mulai teaching period 2027.
items.notes: Dikreditkan setelah census date periode pertama; dapat digabung dengan beasiswa UniSC lain.

en.name: UniSC International Welcome Grant
en.coverage: Credit towards tuition/university fees equal to the student visa fee (OSHC not included)
en.eligibility: New primary student-visa applicants with a UniSC CoE, min. 48 units at UniSC, starting in a 2027 teaching period.
en.notes: Credited after the census date of the first period; can be combined with other UniSC scholarships.

items.name: International Excellence Scholarship 2027
items.fields: Semua bidang (program CRICOS; kecuali program berkuota)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition tahunan, diterapkan tiap term
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional full-fee yang mulai 2027 di program S1/S2 coursework CRICOS, latar akademik kuat, tinggal maks. 50 km dari kampus; bukan penerima Australia Awards/sponsor.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar; sekitar 500 penerima (indikatif).

en.name: International Excellence Scholarship 2027
en.fields: All fields (CRICOS programmes; except quota programmes)
en.coverage: Annual tuition reduction, applied each term
en.eligibility: Full-fee international students starting in 2027 in a CRICOS Bachelor's/coursework Master's, strong academic background, living max. 50 km from campus; not Australia Awards/sponsored recipients.
en.notes: Assessed automatically on application; about 500 recipients (indicative).

items.name: The Sir William Angliss International Merit Scholarships (VIC/NSW)
items.coverage: Dana untuk pengembangan keterampilan, perjalanan, biaya hidup, dan perlengkapan studi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional aktif penuh waktu (VET/Higher Education) di Melbourne/Sydney yang telah menyelesaikan min. 1 semester dan berprestasi akademik.
items.notes: Untuk mahasiswa yang sudah kuliah di William Angliss. Tanggal tutup tidak tercantum di halaman.

en.name: The Sir William Angliss International Merit Scholarships (VIC/NSW)
en.coverage: Funds for skills development, travel, living costs and study equipment
en.eligibility: Current full-time international students (VET/Higher Education) in Melbourne/Sydney who have completed at least 1 semester with strong academic results.
en.notes: For students already studying at William Angliss. No closing date shown on the page.

items.name: TAFE NSW 15% Higher Education Scholarship
items.coverage: Kredit tuition setiap semester (program tertentu: kredit AUD 1.000)
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional program Higher Education TAFE NSW; berbasis prestasi, dinilai panel beasiswa.
items.notes: Gunakan TAFE NSW International Scholarship Application Form; tutup pukul 17.00 AEST pada tanggal mulai kursus di offer letter.

en.name: TAFE NSW 15% Higher Education Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition credit each semester (some programmes: AUD 1,000 credit)
en.eligibility: International students in TAFE NSW Higher Education programmes; merit-based, assessed by a scholarship panel.
en.notes: Use the TAFE NSW International Scholarship Application Form; closes 5 pm AEST on the course start date in the offer letter.

items.name: TAFE NSW $500 Vocational Course Scholarship
items.coverage: Kredit tuition vokasi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional pada kursus vokasi tertentu (daftar di PDF TAFE NSW); berbasis prestasi.
items.notes: Formulir sama dengan beasiswa 15%; tutup pada tanggal mulai kursus.

en.name: TAFE NSW $500 Vocational Course Scholarship
en.coverage: Vocational tuition credit
en.eligibility: International students in selected vocational courses (list in the TAFE NSW PDF); merit-based.
en.notes: Same form as the 15% scholarship; closes on the course start date.

items.name: AUD$5,000 WA Regional TAFE International Student Bursary
items.fields: Commercial Cookery, Patisserie, Nursing, Early Childhood, Community Services, IT, Individual Support
items.coverage: Bursary tunai (2 x AUD 2.500 atau 1 x AUD 5.000)
items.eligibility: Pelajar internasional visa 500 yang mulai 2027/2028 pada paket kursus regional (Geraldton, Kalgoorlie, Northam, Albany, Bunbury, Mandurah), tinggal di lokasi regional selama masa bursary.
items.notes: Penawaran waktu terbatas; daftar melalui portal TIWA untuk paket yang memenuhi syarat.

en.name: AUD$5,000 WA Regional TAFE International Student Bursary
en.fields: Commercial Cookery, Patisserie, Nursing, Early Childhood, Community Services, IT, Individual Support
en.coverage: Cash bursary (2 x AUD 2,500 or 1 x AUD 5,000)
en.eligibility: International subclass 500 students starting in 2027/2028 in a regional course package (Geraldton, Kalgoorlie, Northam, Albany, Bunbury, Mandurah), living in the regional location for the bursary period.
en.notes: Limited-time offer; apply via the TIWA portal for eligible packages.

items.name: SIHE 25% Offshore Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa baru yang mendaftar dari luar Australia dengan kemampuan bahasa Inggris memadai.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai tim Admissions. Halaman menyebut intake November 2026; konfirmasi untuk intake 2027.

en.name: SIHE 25% Offshore Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: New students applying from outside Australia with adequate English.

en.name: Higher Education Eagle Awards

en.eligibility: Current HE students (4 subjects/semester, min. 2 semesters) with 30-32 merit points, no academic misconduct or outstanding fees.

en.name: Melbourne International Excellence Scholarship (Undergraduate)

en.eligibility: Receive a Bachelor's offer (Overseas Fee place) starting in 2027, with no previous university study; ranked by entry score.
en.notes: Status 'Open for automatic consideration'; at least 140 recipients (indicative). Notification within 5 working days after the offer.

items.name: UNSW International Scientia Coursework Scholarship
items.coverage: Tuition penuh (Offer 1) atau AUD 20.000/tahun (Offer 2) selama durasi minimum program
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional dengan offer UNSW Term 1 2027; seleksi berdasarkan prestasi akademik, kepemimpinan, dan motivasi.

en.coverage: Full tuition (Offer 1) or AUD 20,000/year (Offer 2) for the minimum programme duration
en.eligibility: International students with a UNSW Term 1 2027 offer; selected on academic merit, leadership and motivation.

items.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme (VCIS)

items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi; otomatis dinilai bagi pemegang offer tanpa syarat. Penerima beasiswa Pemerintah Australia tidak memenuhi syarat.

en.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme (VCIS)
en.coverage: First-year tuition support
en.eligibility: International students with an unconditional offer for a Bachelor's/coursework Master's before the round closing date; based on academic merit.
en.intake: Semester 1 2027 (Round 3); Semester 2 2027 rounds close 15 Feb, 22 Mar, 3 May 2027
en.notes: No application; assessed automatically for unconditional offer holders. Australian Government scholarship recipients are not eligible.

items.name: UQ International Excellence Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition per semester selama masa program
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional penuh waktu yang mulai 2027, memenuhi syarat masuk & bahasa Inggris dan memiliki skor kompetitif; tidak menerima sponsor penuh.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar; tenggat penerimaan diberitahukan bersama offer.

en.name: UQ International Excellence Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction per semester for the programme duration
en.eligibility: Full-time international students starting in 2027, meeting entry & English requirements with a competitive score; not fully sponsored.
en.notes: Assessed automatically on application; the acceptance deadline is given with the offer.

items.name: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi; kemungkinan jaminan akomodasi tahun pertama
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional dengan offer program yang memenuhi syarat, berbasis prestasi akademik; tidak menerima sponsor tuition.

en.name: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study; possible guaranteed first-year accommodation
en.eligibility: International students with an offer for an eligible programme, based on academic merit; not tuition-sponsored.
en.notes: The page says 'currently unavailable' and only refers to 2026 admissions; there is a specific Indonesia category. Watch for 2027.

items.name: Adelaide Merit Scholarship (15%)
items.fields: Semua bidang (kecuali beberapa program kesehatan, kedokteran hewan, MBA)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S1 (ATAR min. 75 atau setara) atau S2 (GPA min. 5.0/7 atau setara); bukan penerima Australia Awards.

en.name: Adelaide Merit Scholarship (15%)
en.fields: All fields (except some health programmes, veterinary science, MBA)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: New international Bachelor's students (ATAR min. 75 or equivalent) or Master's students (GPA min. 5.0/7 or equivalent); not Australia Awards recipients.
en.notes: Assessed automatically on application. Adelaide University is the merger of the University of Adelaide & UniSA. There is also a 50% Academic Excellence Scholarship.

items.name: UWA Global Excellence Scholarship
items.fields: Semua bidang (kecuali JD, MD, DMD, OD)

items.eligibility: S1: ATAR setara min. 85 (10%) / 90 (20%); S2: WAM min. 65 (10%) / 75 (20%); offer untuk program 2027; terbuka untuk semua negara.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai setelah transkrip akhir diserahkan.

en.name: UWA Global Excellence Scholarship
en.fields: All fields (except JD, MD, DMD, OD)
en.coverage: Annual tuition reduction for the standard duration
en.eligibility: Bachelor's: ATAR equivalent min. 85 (10%) / 90 (20%); Master's: WAM min. 65 (10%) / 75 (20%); offer for a 2027 programme; open to all countries.
en.notes: Assessed automatically after final transcripts are submitted.

items.name: Deakin Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
items.fields: Semua bidang coursework (kecuali Doctor of Medicine)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition 100% atau 50% selama masa studi, prioritas akomodasi, program VCPEP
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru dengan rata-rata min. 85% (atau setara), memenuhi syarat bahasa Inggris program; esai 300 kata dan 2 referensi.

en.name: Deakin Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
en.fields: All coursework fields (except Doctor of Medicine)
en.coverage: 100% or 50% tuition reduction for the duration of study, accommodation priority, VCPEP programme
en.eligibility: New international students with an average of at least 85% (or equivalent), meeting the programme's English requirement; 300-word essay and 2 references.
en.intake: 2027 trimesters (assessed on a rolling basis before each trimester)
en.notes: Submit the form at least 1 month before study starts. Unsuccessful applicants are automatically considered for the 20% Deakin International Scholarship.

items.name: RMIT Academic Merit Scholarship for Southeast Asia
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Warga negara Indonesia/Asia Tenggara yang mendaftar dari luar Australia, GPA setara 2.5 (atau rata-rata 70%/ATAR 75); penerima LPDP tetap boleh.
items.notes: Dibuka sekarang hingga kuota penuh (first-come-first-served); terima offer & bayar deposit dalam 14 hari.

en.name: RMIT Academic Merit Scholarship for Southeast Asia
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: Indonesian/Southeast Asian citizens applying from outside Australia, GPA equivalent 2.5 (or 70% average/ATAR 75); LPDP recipients are still eligible.
en.notes: Open now until places are filled (first come, first served); accept the offer & pay the deposit within 14 days.

items.name: UTS Academic Excellence International Scholarship

en.name: UTS Academic Excellence International Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the programme's standard credit points
en.eligibility: New international students meeting entry requirements and studying full-time on campus in Sydney, starting 2025-2028.
en.notes: Considered automatically; no extra documents needed.

en.coverage: Tuition reduction for up to 4 years (Bachelor's) / 2 years (Master's)
en.eligibility: Non-sponsored international students studying at a Curtin WA campus with Distinction standing (required grade average).
en.notes: No separate application; the scholarship letter is sent with the Letter of Offer.

en.notes: Assessed automatically; shown in the Letter of Offer. Deferring to 2028 makes you ineligible.

items.name: QUT International Merit Scholarship

items.notes: Otomatis dinilai dari aplikasi studi; tanggal tidak tercantum.

en.notes: Assessed automatically from the study application; dates not listed.

items.name: Beasiswa Pemerintah Jepang (MEXT/Monbukagakusho) - Research Student (rekomendasi Kedutaan)

items.english_test: TOEFL / IELTS / TOEIC (ETS) atau JLPT N2 - skor minimum lihat halaman Kedubes
items.notes: Pendaftaran via Kedubes biasanya April-Mei, ujian tertulis Juni, wawancara Juli, berangkat April tahun berikutnya. Putaran keberangkatan 2027 sudah tutup.

en.name: Japanese Government (MEXT/Monbukagakusho) Scholarship - Research Student (Embassy recommendation)

en.eligibility: D4/Bachelor's/Master's graduates, max. age 34 on 1 April of the departure year, recommended GPA min. 3.2, TOEFL/IELTS/TOEIC (ETS) certificate or JLPT N2 required.
en.english_test: TOEFL / IELTS / TOEIC (ETS) or JLPT N2 - see the Embassy page for minimum scores
en.intake: April / October of the following year
en.notes: Embassy applications usually run April-May, written exam in June, interview in July, departure the following April. The round for 2027 departure is closed.

en.name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship - Undergraduate (Gakubu), Kosen & Senshu
en.provider: Japanese Government (MEXT) via the Embassy of Japan in Indonesia
en.coverage: Full tuition, monthly allowance, return airfare, 1 year of Japanese language preparation
en.eligibility: High school graduates, max. age 24 on 1 April of the departure year, semester 1-5 report grades min. 84 in required subjects (Mathematics, English, Chemistry for science).
en.notes: Classes are taught in Japanese. In the previous cycle registration ran from mid-April to early May.

items.name: Asian Development Bank - Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP)

items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tunjangan bulanan (termasuk akomodasi), buku, asuransi kesehatan, tiket pesawat
items.eligibility: WNI, S1 dengan prestasi akademik unggul, min. 2 tahun pengalaman kerja penuh waktu, usia maks. 35 tahun, diterima di program S2 institusi mitra, bersedia kembali ke Indonesia min. 2 tahun.
items.notes: Daftar melalui salah satu dari 27 institusi mitra (17 di Jepang); tenggat ditentukan masing-masing institusi.

en.name: Asian Development Bank - Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP)

en.coverage: Full tuition, monthly allowance (including accommodation), books, health insurance, airfare
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with an excellent Bachelor's record, min. 2 years of full-time work experience, max. age 35, admitted to a Master's at a partner institution, willing to return to Indonesia for at least 2 years.
en.notes: Apply through one of the 27 partner institutions (17 in Japan); each institution sets its own deadline.

items.name: Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students (JASSO)

items.eligibility: Mahasiswa asing berstatus Student di Jepang, IPK min. 2,30, kemampuan bahasa Jepang (JLPT N2/EJU 200+) atau Inggris (CEFR B2); bisa via Reservation Program EJU sebelum berangkat.
items.english_test: CEFR B2 (atau JLPT N2 / EJU Bahasa Jepang 200+)
items.notes: Diajukan melalui kampus di Jepang (kuota rekomendasi terbatas) atau Reservation Program EJU.

en.name: Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students (JASSO)
en.coverage: Monthly allowance for self-funded students
en.eligibility: International students with Student status in Japan, GPA min. 2.30, Japanese (JLPT N2/EJU 200+) or English (CEFR B2) ability; available before departure via the EJU Reservation Program.
en.english_test: CEFR B2 (or JLPT N2 / EJU Japanese 200+)
en.notes: Apply through a university in Japan (limited recommendation quota) or the EJU Reservation Program.

en.eligibility: Under 40, grades min. 80/100 or top 20% or GPA min. 2.64/4.0, not a graduate of a Korean high school/university; Indonesia Embassy-track quota 33 people (GKS-G 2026).

en.coverage: Tuition, monthly allowance, airfare, 1-year Korean language course, insurance
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens (parents not Korean citizens), under 25, high school graduates or graduating students; Indonesia Embassy-track quota 4 people (GKS-U 2026).

en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with a Bachelor's degree, work experience and leadership potential, applying to 3 one-year Master's programmes in the UK, willing to return to Indonesia after study; no age limit.
en.notes: Applications for 2027-28 (August-October 2026) are closed; the next round usually opens in August.

items.notes: Tenggat 15 Februari sesuai halaman Deadlines AMINEF.

en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens going on to a doctoral programme at a US university; dependants are not funded.
en.notes: Deadline 15 February according to the AMINEF Deadlines page.

items.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tunjangan hidup, tiket pesawat, asuransi
items.eligibility: WNI untuk studi pascasarjana (Master/PhD) di institusi Selandia Baru; syarat rinci di situs resmi.
items.notes: Intake 2027 untuk Indonesia ditutup 31 Maret 2026 (pengumuman Kemdiktisaintek). Tersedia juga Short Term Training Scholarships.

en.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
en.coverage: Full tuition, living allowance, airfare, insurance
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens for postgraduate study (Master's/PhD) at New Zealand institutions; detailed requirements on the official site.
en.notes: The 2027 intake for Indonesia closed on 31 March 2026 (Ministry announcement). Short Term Training Scholarships are also available.

items.name: Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development (SEED-2)
items.coverage: Tunjangan untuk studi/riset jangka pendek (pertukaran) di Kanada
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa WNI terdaftar penuh waktu di perguruan tinggi negara ASEAN dengan perjanjian/kerja sama dengan institusi Kanada; diajukan oleh institusi Kanada.
items.notes: Bukan program gelar. Halaman terakhir menampilkan siklus 2025 (tenggat 31 Maret 2025); siklus berikutnya belum diumumkan.

en.name: Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development (SEED-2)
en.coverage: Allowance for short-term study/research (exchange) in Canada
en.eligibility: Indonesian students enrolled full-time at a higher-education institution in an ASEAN country that has an agreement/partnership with a Canadian institution; nominated by the Canadian institution.
en.notes: Not a degree programme. The latest page shows the 2025 cycle (deadline 31 March 2025); the next cycle has not been announced.

items.name: NL Scholarship (dahulu Holland Scholarship)
items.provider: Kementerian Pendidikan Belanda (OCW) bersama universitas Belanda
items.coverage: Dana tunai di tahun pertama studi
items.eligibility: Kewarganegaraan non-EEA (termasuk WNI), mendaftar program S1/S2 penuh waktu di institusi Belanda peserta, belum pernah memiliki gelar dari Belanda.
items.notes: Periode aplikasi 2027-2028 sudah dibuka; tenggat ditetapkan masing-masing institusi. StuNed sudah dihentikan (Programme Concluded).

en.name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
en.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education (OCW) with Dutch universities
en.coverage: Cash grant in the first year of study
en.eligibility: Non-EEA nationality (including Indonesian), applying for a full-time Bachelor's/Master's at a participating Dutch institution, with no previous Dutch degree.
en.notes: The 2027-2028 application period is open; deadlines are set by each institution. StuNed has ended (Programme Concluded).

items.name: DAAD - Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
items.fields: Bidang terkait pembangunan (sesuai daftar program EPOS)
items.coverage: Tunjangan bulanan, asuransi, biaya perjalanan; durasi 1-3 tahun
items.eligibility: Lulusan dengan min. 2 tahun pengalaman kerja profesional; melamar langsung ke program EPOS yang dipilih.
items.notes: Tenggat berbeda per program (lihat DAAD Scholarship Database). DAAD Indonesia memperpanjang tenggat beberapa program hingga 28 Okt 2026 (sudah lewat).

en.name: DAAD - Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
en.fields: Development-related fields (per the EPOS programme list)
en.coverage: Monthly allowance, insurance, travel costs; duration 1-3 years
en.eligibility: Graduates with at least 2 years of professional work experience; apply directly to the chosen EPOS programme.
en.notes: Deadlines differ per programme (see the DAAD Scholarship Database). DAAD Indonesia extended some programme deadlines to 28 Oct 2026 (passed).

items.name: DAAD Research Grants - Doctoral Programmes in Germany
items.coverage: Tunjangan bulanan, asuransi, biaya perjalanan, kursus bahasa; hingga 4 tahun
items.eligibility: Lulusan S2 dengan kualifikasi di atas rata-rata yang akan menempuh doktoral di Jerman.
items.notes: Putaran tahun ini sudah lewat (perpanjangan tenggat beberapa program DAAD hingga 28 Okt 2026). Tersedia juga skema Bi-nationally Supervised Doctoral dan STEM Study Scholarships.

en.name: DAAD Research Grants - Doctoral Programmes in Germany
en.coverage: Monthly allowance, insurance, travel costs, language course; up to 4 years
en.eligibility: Master's graduates with above-average qualifications going on to a doctorate in Germany.
en.notes: This year's round has passed (some DAAD programme deadlines were extended to 28 Oct 2026). Bi-nationally Supervised Doctoral and STEM Study Scholarships are also available.

items.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Scholarships
items.coverage: Biaya partisipasi (tuition), kontribusi biaya perjalanan, visa, dan tunjangan hidup
items.eligibility: Terbuka untuk mahasiswa seluruh dunia termasuk WNI; memiliki gelar S1 atau di tahun terakhir S1; daftar langsung ke konsorsium program.
items.notes: Sebagian besar program menerima aplikasi Oktober-Januari; tenggat per program, cek katalog EACEA.

en.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Scholarships
en.coverage: Participation costs (tuition), contribution to travel, visa and living costs
en.eligibility: Open to students worldwide including Indonesians; hold a Bachelor's degree or be in the final year; apply directly to the programme consortium.
en.notes: Most programmes accept applications October-January; deadlines per programme, see the EACEA catalogue.

items.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
items.fields: Semua bidang (sesuai daftar program untuk Indonesia)
items.coverage: Pembebasan tuition, tunjangan bulanan, akomodasi/bantuan akomodasi, asuransi kesehatan
items.eligibility: WNI dari negara mitra pengirim (Indonesia terdaftar sebagai Sending Partner); memenuhi syarat program yang dipilih.
items.notes: Situs menyatakan aplikasi 2026/27 sudah ditutup (submit hingga 15 Jan 2026); call 2027/28 belum diumumkan.

en.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
en.fields: All fields (per the programme list for Indonesia)
en.coverage: Tuition waiver, monthly allowance, accommodation/accommodation support, health insurance
en.eligibility: Citizens of sending partner countries (Indonesia is listed as a Sending Partner); meet the chosen programme's requirements.
en.notes: The site says 2026/27 applications are closed (submission until 15 Jan 2026); the 2027/28 call has not been announced.

items.name: Türkiye Burslari (Türkiye Scholarships)
items.coverage: Penempatan universitas, tuition, tunjangan bulanan, akomodasi, asuransi kesehatan, kursus bahasa Turki 1 tahun, tiket pesawat sekali PP
items.eligibility: Terbuka untuk warga negara asing termasuk WNI; syarat usia dan nilai per jenjang lihat situs resmi.
items.notes: Kalender resmi: periode aplikasi umum 10 Januari - 20 Februari (tahun 2027 belum dikonfirmasi). Ada juga Research Scholarship 4 periode per tahun.

en.name: Türkiye Burslari (Türkiye Scholarships)
en.coverage: University placement, tuition, monthly allowance, accommodation, health insurance, 1-year Turkish language course, one return airfare
en.eligibility: Open to foreign nationals including Indonesians; age and grade requirements per level on the official site.
en.notes: Official calendar: the general application period is 10 January - 20 February (2027 not yet confirmed). There is also a Research Scholarship with 4 periods per year.

items.name: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education)
items.provider: Kementerian Pendidikan Taiwan (MOE) via TETO Jakarta
items.coverage: Tuition & biaya kampus (hingga NTD 40.000/semester) dan tunjangan hidup bulanan
items.amount: Tuition s.d. NTD 40.000/semester; tunjangan S1 NTD 15.000/bulan
items.eligibility: Bukan WN Taiwan/overseas compatriot, belum kuliah di Taiwan pada jenjang yang sama; lampirkan sertifikat bahasa Inggris/Mandarin.
items.notes: Aplikasi diajukan melalui Taipei Economic and Trade Office (TETO) di Jakarta; jadwal 2027 belum diumumkan di sumber resmi.

en.name: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education)
en.provider: Taiwan Ministry of Education (MOE) via TETO Jakarta
en.coverage: Tuition & campus fees (up to NTD 40,000/semester) and monthly living allowance
en.amount: Tuition up to NTD 40,000/semester; Bachelor's allowance NTD 15,000/month
en.eligibility: Not a Taiwanese citizen/overseas compatriot, not previously studied in Taiwan at the same level; attach an English/Mandarin certificate.
en.notes: Apply through the Taipei Economic and Trade Office (TETO) in Jakarta; the 2027 schedule has not been announced in official sources.

items.name: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program
items.provider: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF)
items.fields: Program tertentu (a.l. kesehatan, akuakultur, teknik industri, pertanian, TI)
items.coverage: Tiket pesawat PP, asrama, tuition, asuransi, buku, tunjangan bulanan
items.eligibility: WNI (Indonesia termasuk negara Asia Pasifik yang eligible) dan memenuhi syarat program studi ICDF yang dipilih.
items.notes: Siklus sebelumnya dibuka 1 Desember s.d. 15 Maret; 11 mahasiswa Indonesia menerima beasiswa ini pada 2026.

en.name: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program
en.provider: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF)
en.fields: Selected programmes (incl. health, aquaculture, industrial engineering, agriculture, IT)
en.coverage: Return airfare, dormitory, tuition, insurance, books, monthly allowance
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens (Indonesia is an eligible Asia-Pacific country) meeting the requirements of the chosen ICDF programme.
en.english_test: As required by the programme (English-taught programmes)
en.notes: The previous cycle ran 1 December to 15 March; 11 Indonesian students received this scholarship in 2026.

items.name: Chinese Government Scholarship 2027/2028 - China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
items.provider: Pemerintah Tiongkok (China Scholarship Council) via Kedutaan Besar RRT di Jakarta
items.coverage: Beasiswa penuh (tidak termasuk tiket pesawat internasional)
items.eligibility: Usia maks.: S1 <25, S2 <35, S3 <40 tahun; S1 wajib skor CSCA; program berbahasa Mandarin HSK 4 (S2/S3), program berbahasa Inggris IELTS/TOEFL sesuai kampus; wajib pre-admission letter.
items.english_test: IELTS/TOEFL sesuai syarat universitas (atau HSK 4 untuk program berbahasa Mandarin)
items.notes: Agency Number Indonesia 3602; daftar online sebelum 14 Feb 2027, tanpa berkas fisik. 20 kuota. Hasil Juli-Agustus 2027.

en.name: Chinese Government Scholarship 2027/2028 - China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
en.provider: Chinese Government (China Scholarship Council) via the PRC Embassy in Jakarta
en.coverage: Full scholarship (international airfare not included)
en.eligibility: Max. age: Bachelor's <25, Master's <35, PhD <40; Bachelor's requires a CSCA score; Mandarin-taught programmes HSK 4 (Master's/PhD), English-taught programmes IELTS/TOEFL per university; pre-admission letter required.
en.english_test: IELTS/TOEFL as required by the university (or HSK 4 for Mandarin-taught programmes)
en.notes: Indonesia Agency Number 3602; apply online before 14 Feb 2027, no hard copies. 20 places. Results July-August 2027.

items.name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tunjangan bulanan, tunjangan tiket pesawat dan settling-in
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional (non-WN/PR Singapura) dengan nilai S1/S2 sangat baik dan minat riset sains & teknik.
items.notes: Dua jendela per tahun: intake Agustus (2 Jun-1 Des) dan intake Januari (2 Des-1 Jun).

en.name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
en.coverage: Full tuition, monthly allowance, airfare and settling-in allowance
en.eligibility: International students (not Singapore citizens/PR) with excellent Bachelor's/Master's results and an interest in science & engineering research.
en.notes: Two windows per year: August intake (2 Jun-1 Dec) and January intake (2 Dec-1 Jun).

items.name: ASEAN Scholarship (Indonesia)
items.coverage: Biaya sekolah dan tunjangan di sekolah menengah pilihan di Singapura
items.eligibility: Siswa WNI untuk masuk Secondary 1 atau Secondary 3 di sekolah tertentu di Singapura (JC1 tidak dibuka untuk Indonesia).
items.notes: Periode aplikasi biasanya Januari-Februari; saat ini ditutup untuk semua negara.

en.name: ASEAN Scholarship (Indonesia)
en.coverage: School fees and allowances at selected secondary schools in Singapore
en.eligibility: Indonesian students entering Secondary 1 or Secondary 3 at selected schools in Singapore (JC1 is not open to Indonesia).
en.notes: The application period is usually January-February; currently closed for all countries.

items.name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship (BDGS)
items.coverage: Rincian manfaat tercantum di portal BDGS
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa asing; usia maks. 25 tahun (Diploma/S1) atau 35 tahun (S2) per 1 Juli tahun mulai studi.
items.notes: Putaran 2026/2027 ditutup 15 Feb 2026; putaran 2027/2028 belum diumumkan. Situs mfa.gov.bn tidak dapat diakses saat pengecekan.

en.name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship (BDGS)
en.provider: Government of Brunei Darussalam (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
en.coverage: Benefit details are listed on the BDGS portal
en.eligibility: International students; max. age 25 (Diploma/Bachelor's) or 35 (Master's) on 1 July of the start year.
en.notes: The 2026/2027 round closed on 15 Feb 2026; the 2027/2028 round has not been announced. The mfa.gov.bn site could not be reached during the check.

items.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
items.provider: Kementerian Eropa dan Luar Negeri Prancis (dikelola Campus France)
items.coverage: Tunjangan bulanan, tiket pesawat PP, asuransi kesehatan, kegiatan budaya (tuition tidak termasuk)
items.eligibility: Calon mahasiswa asing usia maks. 29 tahun (Master) atau 35 tahun (PhD); aplikasi diajukan oleh institusi pendidikan tinggi Prancis, bukan individu.
items.notes: Call 2027 dibuka Oktober 2026; 6 Jan 2027 adalah tenggat kampus mengirim berkas ke Campus France, sehingga tenggat internal kampus lebih awal. Hasil mulai 12 Apr 2027.

en.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
en.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (managed by Campus France)
en.coverage: Monthly allowance, return airfare, health insurance, cultural activities (tuition not included)
en.eligibility: Prospective international students max. age 29 (Master's) or 35 (PhD); applications are submitted by French higher-education institutions, not individuals.
en.notes: The 2027 call opened in October 2026; 6 Jan 2027 is the deadline for institutions to submit files to Campus France, so internal university deadlines are earlier. Results from 12 Apr 2027.

items.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
items.fields: Semua bidang (program master yang memenuhi syarat)
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tunjangan hidup, hibah perjalanan, asuransi
items.eligibility: Warga negara dari daftar negara eligible SI, memiliki pengalaman kerja dan kepemimpinan, serta mendaftar program master di Swedia melalui universityadmissions.se.
items.notes: Situs si.se tidak dapat diakses saat pengecekan; pastikan Indonesia ada di daftar negara eligible untuk 2027/28. Pemerintah RI (Kementerian PU) menawarkan program ini kepada pegawainya pada Januari 2026.

en.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
en.coverage: Full tuition, living allowance, travel grant, insurance
en.eligibility: Citizens of SI's eligible countries with work and leadership experience, applying for a Master's programme in Sweden via universityadmissions.se.
en.notes: The si.se site could not be reached during the check; confirm that Indonesia is on the 2027/28 eligible country list. The Indonesian Government (Ministry of Public Works) offered this programme to its staff in January 2026.

items.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
items.coverage: Pembebasan tuition penuh dan stipend 1 tahun
items.eligibility: Domisili asal di luar EU/EEA, Swiss dan Inggris (WNI memenuhi), memiliki LoA bersyarat/tanpa syarat dari institusi Irlandia, belum pernah menerima GOI-IES; 60 beasiswa per tahun.
items.notes: Putaran 2026 ditutup 12 Maret 2026; call berikutnya belum diumumkan.

en.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
en.coverage: Full tuition waiver and 1-year stipend
en.eligibility: Domiciled outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK (Indonesians qualify), holding a conditional/unconditional LoA from an Irish institution, not a previous GOI-IES recipient; 60 scholarships per year.
en.notes: The 2026 round closed on 12 March 2026; the next call has not been announced.
